scope: Read-only inventory of scientific CSV/JSON under outputs/ and docs/. No secrets, source edits, moves, or scoring changes.

recommended_sheets.notes: Earth↔Mars only; four themes; distinguish experimental descriptors from confidence; no novelty clearance.
Add run_id, window_km=100, sample_spacing_km=4 or 10, slope_stencil_km=8 or20. Do not call the sensitivity run 10km windows.
Add run_id and mars_target. Original terrain_distance lower-is-closer; not calibrated similarity %.

Use primary handoff to avoid reimporting identical results.json/results_with_context/shortlist.csv. Preserve those redundant files in provenance/index. Composite ID run_id + candidate_id; coordinate changes across runs.
26 time keys each (24 monthly+2 annual). Wide columns for 5 parameters. Mark 202313 and202413 annual; -999 fill missing, source unit preserved. These are 2m air temperatures, not MODIS LST.
100km support. Flatten terrain, thermal inertia, shallow/deep ice, dust MY34/MY35 summary, temperature statuses; preserve unit and count fields.
Add purpose and original_order IDs I/D/F01..08. No new scoring. Only 15 reviewed; 4 reporting cards. All novelty unchecked; firm engineering purpose dropped.
Preserve same-purpose/site statuses, prior-art scope and citations. Do not equate coordinate non-hit to novelty.
Native coverage stats, neighboring interpolation weights, exact raw errors, nominal 2015-envelope scope; deep SWIM context shares inputs.
Append target and Mars year parsed from filename. Keep cdodtot/cdod610/cdodrel distinct; IR9.3μm absorption vs Earth visibleAOT different.
Add requested+selected coordinates and scoring_eligible=false.5deg grid, MY29–36,36Ls bins peryear. Nulls are unknown not0; 03/15 sample contrast not same-sol daily extreme.
Provisional unqualified. Separate qualified_windows/provisional windows metadata from summary.json; no global/region mapping.
gale-01 Oytag prior-analog evidence unresolved specific outcrop; do not merge global candidate IDs across runs. Supplement samples distinct from three literature points.
May keep separate tables within one sheet; source-specific column names differ. Could use separate distinct sheets if better readability.

recommended_sheets.source: docs/earth_inventory.csv(222), repository_inventory.csv(123),sources metadata plus current local file paths
recommended_sheets.notes: Large TIFF/NC/HDF grids stay original, referenced by path, bytes, units, resolution, period, sha256. Download manifests indicate discovered products, not necessarily downloaded or used.

join_and_interpretation_hazards: analysis vs analysis_scale10km use same candidate_id strings for different locations; ID alone is unsafe.
Primary and sensitivity analyses both window_km=100; sample spacing and slope stencil differ.
results.json, results_with_context.json, shortlist.csv and matching_data.json overlap heavily; preserve provenance without counting as independent data.
Mars discovery 0.5degree cell summaries differ from 100km reference region profiles and Earth terrain windows.
Mars descriptor score high-is-close vs terrain_distance low-is-close; neither confidence nor percent similarity.
POWER annual YYYY13 time keys must not be treated as months or mixed into monthly averages.
Earth T2M air temperature, MODIS LST, Mars regional/model-corrected surface temperature and TES thermal inertia are different quantities.
SWIM ice consistency is not ice amount/probability and shallow/deep products share inputs.
MODIS precipitation/NDVI/AOD/LST manifests are acquisition metadata, not extracted scientific values.
Some research files preserve historical or provisional snapshot statuses; retain as-of/source rather than overwrite newer QA status.
No evidence establishes four new discovery points already paired to Earth analogs.
